english_draft: Microsoft’s FY2027 Q1, ended September 30, 2026 and published October 28, 2026, is the latest official release. Revenue was USD 92.3 billion, up 19% year over year. GAAP operating income was USD 45.9 billion, up 21% year over year. This maps to calendar 2026 Q3. No same-period preview was available, so this is post-release analysis only. Source: Microsoft investor press release webcast.
